page.layout: Two woodcut medallions at the top, left and right, with ring legends (not running text); below them one column of text with two paragraphs, then an italic verse line followed by a continuation paragraph. Running head centred at top; page number at top right.

main_text.p: THESEVS Ægei Athenárum Regis filius , ex Æthra Pithei filia, regnauit Athenis anno mundi 2730. ante Christum natum 1232. Hic Herculem imitatus,mare ingressus est: ad ea certamina adiecit animum, quæ laudem & gloriam sibi essent allatura: iuuenis adhuc Creontem tyrannum occîdit: præterea taurum vastantem Atticam, & Minotaurum: item Scyronem,Procruftem,& Schynin latrones, in Attica trucidauit. Cum Hercule aduersus Amazonas strenuè militauit, quarum reginam Hippolyten abduxit, ex qua filium Hippolytum suftulit. Iustin lib.2. Diodor.lib.5.Plutarc. in vita Thesei,Ouid. epist.4.& 10. Hic firmam amicitiam cum Pirithoo iunxit.

MINOTAVRVS, filius fuit Pasiphaë, & iuuenis cuiusdam formosissimi,nomine Tauri,qui, morbo laborante Minoë marito Pasiphaës,cum hac concubuit, peperitque Pasiphaë ipsa ex eo concubitu filium,qui inde Minotaurus dictus est,quòd cùm Minoïs filius putaretur , revera tamen Tauri filius esset: quem ideo Minos relegauit,atque infectatus est:ad quem tandem Theseû misit, qui accepto ense ab Ariadne , eum occîdit. Hæc Palephatus libro de non credendis fabulosis narrationibus. De hoc Minotauro multa fabulantur Poëtæ, quòd semiuir, ac semibos fuerit, vnde Ouid.
quòd Labyrintho, à Dædalo fabrefacto inclusus , obiectos sibi homines deuorarit. Vergil.lib.6. Ænei.Ouid.epist.10.

page.notes: The two medallions are woodcut portraits with ring legends. The left one reads THESEVS. The right one shows a bull and a bearded head; its legend is only partly legible (MINOTAVRVS is inferred from the visible letters), so the second legend line is marked [?]. The verse line is set in italics, indented, and the following prose line starts at the left margin, so it is given as a separate paragraph continuing the same sentence. No marginal notes, catchword or signature on the page.
